rows.Synonyms:
• Babylon Sas 429
• INTereybabeuq
• Pink Tourmaline Babylon
rows.Origin:
Bred by Interplant (Netherlands, before 2012).
Introduced in France by Pépinières Minier in 2012 as 'Queen Babylon Eyes'.
rows.Bloom: White, fuchsia / magenta edges, red flecks. None / no fragrance. Single (4-8 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Height: 20" to 4'11" (50 to 150cm). Width: 20" to 39" (50 to 100cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for container rose.
